# Environmentally suitable areas

```{r}
env_suit<-rast(here("raw_data/Wind/wind_pd_mask_NoMPAs.tif"))
env_suit[env_suit>0]<- 1
#env_suit[is.na(env_suit)]<-0

env_suit_proj<-project(env_suit, "ESRI:54017")
```

```{r}
#env_suit_poly<-as.polygons(env_suit_proj)
#env_suit_sf<-st_as_sf(env_suit_poly)
```

```{r}
# 1. Convert your actual turbine sf points to a binary raster template
# matching your global suitability raster's resolution and extent
turbine_raster <- rasterize(vect(wind_points), env_suit_proj, field = 1, background = 0)

# 2. Apply a focal maximum buffer (e.g., a 5x5 window of pixels) 
# This expands the single turbine pixels into small regional zones
# Adjust the 'w' (window size) depending on your raster resolution
turbine_buffer_rast <- focal(turbine_raster, w = 7, fun = max)

# 3. Combine the layers using a logical OR condition
# A cell is now valid if it is environmentally suitable OR near an existing turbine
final_suit_raster <- (env_suit_proj == 1) | (turbine_buffer_rast == 1)

writeRaster(final_suit_raster, here("output_data/temp/temp_suitability.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

# Wind farm clusters

Helper functions

```{r}
safe_count <- function(feature_u, turbines, type_name, baseline_count, rand_count, suit_count) {
  
  if (nrow(feature_u) == 0) return(NULL) # Handled by empty check
  
  # Fast logical point-in-polygon matrix (returns TRUE/FALSE)
  inside_matrix <- st_intersects(turbines, feature_u, sparse = FALSE)
  overlap_count <- sum(inside_matrix)
  
  tibble(
    rgn_key = unique(turbines$rgn_key)[1],
    num_rand_wind_overlap = overlap_count,
    type = type_name,
    baseline_wind_count = baseline_count,
    rand_turbines = rand_count,
    suitable_turbines = suit_count
  )
}
```

```{r}
safe_empty_feature <- function(feature, iso3, type_name) {
  
  if (is.null(feature) || nrow(feature) == 0) {
    no_feature <- TRUE
  } else {
    feature <- st_make_valid(feature)
    area_km2 <- sum(as.numeric(st_area(feature)) * 1e-6, na.rm = TRUE)
    no_feature <- is.na(area_km2) || area_km2 == 0
  }
  
  if (no_feature) {
    message("Skipping ", iso3, " - ", type_name, ": no feature area in country")
    
    return(list(
      count = tibble(
        rgn_key = iso3,
        type = type_name,
        num_rand_wind_overlap = NA_real_
      )
    ))
  }
  
  NULL
}
```


# Get countries to run
```{r}

country_order <- wind_points %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(rgn_key, sort = TRUE) %>%
  filter(n >= 50) %>%
  mutate(rgn_key = as.character(rgn_key)) %>%
  pull(rgn_key)

```

```{r}
for(i in 1:length(country_order)){
  # Suitable area
  sub_eez<-eez %>% 
    filter(rgn_key == country_order[[i]])
  
  print(country_order[[i]])
  
   if (nrow(sub_eez) == 0) {
    stop(paste("ISO3 code not found:", country_order[[i]]))
  }
  
  # 3. Ensure the polygon matches the raster's Coordinate Reference System (CRS)
  if (st_crs(sub_eez) != st_crs(final_suit_raster)) {
    sub_eez <- st_transform(sub_eez, st_crs(final_suit_raster))
  }
  
  # Convert sf object to a terra SpatVector for speed
  country_vect <- vect(sub_eez)
  
  # 4. CROP FIRST (Cuts the global raster down to a small regional box)
  country_raster_crop <- crop(final_suit_raster, country_vect)
  
  # 5. MASK SECOND (Turns all pixels outside the exact country border to NA)
  country_raster_masked <- mask(country_raster_crop, country_vect)
  
  writeRaster(country_raster_masked, here(paste0("output_data/temp/Suitable_cells_", country_order[[i]], ".tif")))

}
```


# Parallel processing

Write function

```{r}

run_country <- function(iso3){
  
    final_suit_files <- list.files(here("output_data/temp"), full.names = T)
  
#clustered_outputs <- list()
#noise_summary <- list()

  # Subset to country
  sub <- wind_points %>% 
    filter(rgn_key == iso3)
  
  print(iso3)
  
  sub_cluster <- sub %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = dbscan(
      st_coordinates(.),
      eps = 5000,
      minPts = 5
    )$cluster
  )

  
  # Find spatial cluster centroids
 cluster_centroids <- sub_cluster %>%
  filter(cluster_id != 0) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
  st_centroid()
  
  cluster_centroids_df <- cluster_centroids %>%
  mutate(
    centroid_x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    centroid_y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(cluster_id, centroid_x, centroid_y)
  
  # Calculate relative turbine positions
  coords_matrix <- st_coordinates(sub_cluster)

turbines_relative <- sub_cluster %>%
  mutate(
    turbine_x = coords_matrix[, 1],
    turbine_y = coords_matrix[, 2]
  ) %>%
  left_join(cluster_centroids_df, by = "cluster_id") %>%
  mutate(
    # True metric offsets relative to center
    dx = turbine_x - centroid_x,
    dy = turbine_y - centroid_y
  )
  
  # Save clustered turbine output
 # clustered_outputs[[iso3]] <- sub_cluster
  
  noise_summary_row <- tibble(
    rgn_key = iso3,
    n_turbines = nrow(sub_cluster),
    n_clusters = length(unique(sub_cluster$cluster_id[sub_cluster$cluster_id > 0])),
    n_noise = sum(sub_cluster$cluster_id == 0),
    prop_noise = mean(sub_cluster$cluster_id == 0),
    eps = 5000,
    minPts = 5
  )
  
  path <- grep(iso3, final_suit_files, value = TRUE)

# 2. Read the specific raster file

  country_raster_masked<- rast(path)
  candidate_df <- as.data.frame(country_raster_masked, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  candidate_xy <- as.matrix(candidate_df[, c("x", "y")])
                                  
                                  
 if (nrow(candidate_xy) == 0) {
  warning(paste("No candidate cells found in the raster for country:", iso3))
  return(NULL)
}
  
  # Biodiversity layer subsets
  sub_mpa <- mpa %>% 
    filter(rgn_key == iso3) %>% 
    distinct(geometry, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sub_strict <- strict_mpa %>% 
    filter(rgn_key == iso3) %>% 
    distinct(geometry, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sub_kba <- kba %>% 
    filter(rgn_key == iso3) %>% 
    distinct(geometry, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sub_ebsa <- ebsa %>% 
    filter(rgn_key == iso3) %>% 
    distinct(geometry, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  sub_wild <- wild %>% 
    filter(rgn_key == iso3) %>% 
    distinct(geometry, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # Pre-union biodiversity geometries once per country
  # These are only used if the feature is not empty
sub_mpa_u <- if (nrow(sub_mpa) > 0) st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_make_valid(sub_mpa))) else sub_mpa
sub_strict_u <- if (nrow(sub_strict) > 0) st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_make_valid(sub_strict))) else sub_strict
sub_kba_u    <- if (nrow(sub_kba) > 0)    st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_make_valid(sub_kba))) else sub_kba
sub_ebsa_u   <- if (nrow(sub_ebsa) > 0)   st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_make_valid(sub_ebsa))) else sub_ebsa
sub_wild_u   <- if (nrow(sub_wild) > 0)   st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_make_valid(sub_wild))) else sub_wild
  
  # Storage objects
  count_results <- data.frame()
  failed_iterations <- tibble()
  
  #start_time <- Sys.time()
  #cat("Started:", format(start_time), "\n")
  
  cluster_ids <- unique(turbines_relative$cluster_id[turbines_relative$cluster_id > 0])
  
  for (k in 1:10) {
    
    random_turbines_list <- list()
    valid_config <- TRUE
    max_attempts <- 1000
    
    for (cl in cluster_ids) {
      
      this_cluster <- turbines_relative %>%
        filter(cluster_id == cl) %>%
        st_drop_geometry()
      
      cluster_valid <- FALSE
      attempt <- 1
      
          while (!cluster_valid && attempt <= max_attempts) {
      xy <- candidate_xy[sample(seq_len(nrow(candidate_xy)), 1), , drop = FALSE]
      
      theta <- runif(1, 0, 2 * pi)
      scale_factor <- runif(1, 0.7, 1.0)
      
      # Pure numeric math (Lightning fast)
      dx_new <- scale_factor * (this_cluster$dx * cos(theta) - this_cluster$dy * sin(theta))
      dy_new <- scale_factor * (this_cluster$dx * sin(theta) + this_cluster$dy * cos(theta))
      
      new_x_coords <- as.numeric(xy[1, 1]) + dx_new
      new_y_coords <- as.numeric(xy[1, 2]) + dy_new
      
      # Matrix lookup directly into terra extraction
      mat_coords <- cbind(new_x_coords, new_y_coords)
      extracted_vals <- terra::extract(country_raster_masked, mat_coords)[, 1] 
      
      cluster_valid <- all(!is.na(extracted_vals) & extracted_vals == 1)
      
      if (cluster_valid) {
        # ONLY build the heavy sf object once we know this layout works!
        this_try <- this_cluster %>%
          mutate(new_x = new_x_coords, new_y = new_y_coords) %>%
          st_as_sf(coords = c("new_x", "new_y"), crs = crs(country_raster_masked))
      }
      attempt <- attempt + 1
    }
      
      if (!cluster_valid) {
        valid_config <- FALSE
        break
      }
      
      random_turbines_list[[as.character(cl)]] <- this_try
    }
    
    if (!valid_config) {
      failed_iterations <- bind_rows(
        failed_iterations,
        tibble(
          rgn_key = iso3,
          iteration = k,
          reason = "No valid random configuration found",
          max_attempts = max_attempts
        )
      )
      next
    }
    
    random_turbines <- bind_rows(random_turbines_list)
    
    # Already checked that all random turbines are suitable
    # Avoid expensive st_intersection()
    rand_turbines_suit <- random_turbines
    
    # -------------------------
    # Calculate overlap counts
    # -------------------------
    
    # -------------------------
    # Pre-calculate counts for efficiency
    # -------------------------
    base_n  <- nrow(sub)
    rand_n  <- nrow(random_turbines)
    suit_n  <- nrow(rand_turbines_suit)
    
    # -------------------------
    # Process Overlaps cleanly using the new safe_count arguments
    # -------------------------
    
    # MPA
    empty_check <- safe_empty_feature(sub_mpa, iso3, "MPA")
    if (!is.null(empty_check)) {
      mpa_count <- empty_check$count %>% mutate(num_rand_wind_overlap = NA, baseline_wind_count = base_n, rand_turbines = rand_n, suitable_turbines = suit_n)
    } else {
      mpa_count <- safe_count(sub_mpa_u, rand_turbines_suit, "MPA", base_n, rand_n, suit_n)
    }
    
    # Strict MPA
    empty_check <- safe_empty_feature(sub_strict, iso3, "Strict MPA")
    if (!is.null(empty_check)) {
      strict_mpa_count <- empty_check$count %>% mutate(num_rand_wind_overlap = NA, baseline_wind_count = base_n, rand_turbines = rand_n, suitable_turbines = suit_n)
    } else {
      strict_mpa_count <- safe_count(sub_strict_u, rand_turbines_suit, "Strict MPA", base_n, rand_n, suit_n)
    }
    
    # KBA
    empty_check <- safe_empty_feature(sub_kba, iso3, "KBA")
    if (!is.null(empty_check)) {
      kba_count <- empty_check$count %>% mutate(num_rand_wind_overlap = NA, baseline_wind_count = base_n, rand_turbines = rand_n, suitable_turbines = suit_n)
    } else {
      kba_count <- safe_count(sub_kba_u, rand_turbines_suit, "KBA", base_n, rand_n, suit_n)
    }
    
    # EBSA
    empty_check <- safe_empty_feature(sub_ebsa, iso3, "EBSA")
    if (!is.null(empty_check)) {
      ebsa_count <- empty_check$count %>% mutate(num_rand_wind_overlap = NA, baseline_wind_count = base_n, rand_turbines = rand_n, suitable_turbines = suit_n)
    } else {
      ebsa_count <- safe_count(sub_ebsa_u, rand_turbines_suit, "EBSA", base_n, rand_n, suit_n)
    }
    
    # Wilderness
    empty_check <- safe_empty_feature(sub_wild, iso3, "Wilderness")
    if (!is.null(empty_check)) {
      wild_count <- empty_check$count %>% mutate(num_rand_wind_overlap = NA, baseline_wind_count = base_n, rand_turbines = rand_n, suitable_turbines = suit_n)
    } else {
      wild_count <- safe_count(sub_wild_u, rand_turbines_suit, "Wilderness", base_n, rand_n, suit_n)
    }
    
    count_all <- bind_rows(
      mpa_count,
      strict_mpa_count,
      kba_count,
      ebsa_count,
      wild_count
    ) %>% 
      mutate(iteration = k)
    
    count_results <- bind_rows(count_results, count_all)
  }
  
  write.csv(
    count_results,
    here(paste0("output_data/Random_turbines/Random_turbines_count_", iso3, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  write_csv(
    failed_iterations,
    here(paste0("output_data/Random_turbines/Failed_iterations_", iso3, ".csv"))
  )


  list(
    clustered_outputs = sub_cluster,
    noise_summary = noise_summary_row,
    count_results = count_results,
    failed_iterations = failed_iterations
  )
}
```



# Run in parallel with progress bar

```{r}
plan(multisession, workers = 6)
handlers(global = TRUE)
```


```{r}

start<-Sys.time()

with_progress({
  
  p <- progressor(along = country_order)
  
  results <- future_map(
    country_order,
    ~{
      res <- run_country(.x)
      p(sprintf("Finished %s", .x))
      res
    },
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
)
})

end <- Sys.time()
end - start
```

# Combine outputs

```{r}
clustered_outputs_bind <- purrr::map(results, "clustered_outputs") %>%
  bind_rows()

noise_summary_bind <- purrr::map(results, "noise_summary") %>%
  bind_rows()
```
